item.title: Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, Park Ji-won Officially Announce Speaker Candidacy... Candidate Registration (與 조정식·김태년·박지원 국회의장 공식 출마…후보 등록)
item.description:
Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, Park Ji-won Officially Announce Speaker Candidacy... Candidate Registration (與 조정식·김태년·박지원 국회의장 공식 출마…후보 등록)

Ahead of the registration for candidates for the National Assembly Speaker for the latter half of the 22nd term, lawmakers Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, and Park Ji-won of the Democratic Party of Korea will register their candidacies on the 4th. (제22대 국회 후반기 국회의장 후보 등록을 앞두고 조정식·김태년·박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 4일 후보 등록을 한다.)

Six-term lawmaker Cho Jung-sik stated at his campaign press conference, “As the Lee Jae-myung administration is showing the people political efficacy through swift results, it is now time to demonstrate the efficacy of the National Assembly to the public as well.” He added, “As a National Assembly Speaker from the ruling party, I will work to form a single team with the party, government, and presidential office, and alongside the Lee Jae-myung administration, create tangible results that people can feel, turning it into a people-sovereignty assembly and a livelihood-focused assembly.” (6선인 조정식 의원은 이날 출마회견에서 “이재명 정부가 속도감 있는 성과로 국민께 정치의 효능감을 보여주고 있는 만큼, 이제는 국회의 효능감도 국민께 보여드릴 때”라며 “집권여당 출신 국회의장으로 당정청과 국회가 원팀이 되어 이재명 정부와 함께 국민이 체감하는 성과를 만드는 국민주권국회, 민생국회로 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Additionally, Rep. Cho proposed five key pledges: a prioritizing the people’s lives, a working with the public, promoting constitutional amendment, strengthening the role and status of the National Assembly, and systematizing and bolstering support for parliamentary diplomacy. (또 조 의원은 5대 공약으로 국민의 삶을 최우선으로 하는 <민생국회>, 국민과 함께하는 <국민주권국회>, 개헌추진, 국회의 역할과 위상 강화, 의회외교 체계화·지원강화 등을 제시했다.)

Five-term lawmaker Kim Tae-nyeon said at his campaign press conference, “South Korea stands before critical challenges. It is about completing the era of people’s sovereignty through institutions and protecting the nation’s future amid the waves of a great transformation.” As key pledges, Kim stated, “I will establish a strategy meeting for the livelihood economy and elevate parliamentary diplomacy to a national strategy.” (5선 김태년 의원은 이날 출마 회견을 통해 “대한민국은 중대한 과제 앞에 서있다. 국민주권시대를 제도로 완성하는 것이고, 대전환의 파고 앞에서 대한민국의 미래를 지켜내는 것”이라고 했다. 주요 공약으로 김 의원은 “민생경제 전략회의를 신설하고, 의회외교를 국가전략으로 격상하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Speaking with reporters immediately after the press conference, Kim added, “(The priority task is) to make the National Assembly function as it should, properly attending to the people’s lives. Another is constitutional amendment. We must achieve a constitutional revision that encompasses various issues, including restructuring the power structure.” (김 의원은 회견 직후 기자들과 만나선 “(우선 과제는) 국회를 국회답게 국회가 국민의 삶을 챙기는데 잘 작동하도록 만드는 것”이라며 “또 하나는 개헌이다. 권력구조 개편 포함한 여러 과제들 다 헌법에 담아내는 개헌 꼭 해내야 된다”고 했다.)

Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won, in his campaign press conference, said, “I am truly grateful for your overwhelming support, as I ranked first in all four opinion polls.” He added, “By making the Lee Jae-myung administration a success and throwing open the doors to the Seventh Republic, we can achieve the greatest reform of our era! Only by recreating the regime can we finally end the insurrection.” (5선 박지원 의원도 출마 회견에서 “총 4번의 여론조사에서 모두 압도적인 1위로 성원해주셔서 정말 감사하다”며 “이재명 정부를 성공시키고 제7공화국의 문을 활짝 열고, 우리 시대 최고의 개혁! 정권을 재창출해야 비로소 내란을 끝장을 낼 수 있다”고 했다.)

He also stated, “By preemptively reforming the prosecution and judiciary, I will complete the revolution of light faster and more thoroughly.” He emphasized, “This is my last attempt. Age is neither a number nor a bully. An artist’s best work is considered to be their later years.” (또 “검찰개혁, 사법개혁을 선제적으로 정비해서 더 빨리, 더 확실하게 빛의 혁명을 완수하겠다”고도 했다. 그러면서 “저는 마지막이다. 나이는 숫자도 깡패도 아니다. 예술가의 작품은 말년을 최고로 쳐준다”며 강조하기도 했다.)

item.title: North Korean Women's Football Team to Visit South for AFC Match… First North Korean Athlete Visit in 8 Years (北 여자축구단 AFC 경기 참석차 방남…8년만의 北 체육인 방남)
item.description:
North Korean Women's Football Team to Visit South for AFC Match… First North Korean Athlete Visit in 8 Years (北 여자축구단 AFC 경기 참석차 방남…8년만의 北 체육인 방남)

North Korea’s “Naegohyang Women’s Football Team” will visit South Korea to participate in the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women’s Champions League match held on the 20th in Suwon. This marks the first time North Korea has sent a delegation to a sports event in South Korea since shifting inter-Korean relations to a "hostile belligerent" stance, and it is the first visit by North Korean athletes in eight years since 2018. (북한의 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 오는 20일 경기 수원에서 열리는 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스 리그 경기 참석차 방남한다. 북한이 남북관계를 ‘적대적 교전국’ 관계로 전환한 이후 남한에서 열리는 스포츠 행사에 처음 선수단을 보내는 것으로, 북한 체육인의 방남은 2018년 이후 8년만이다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification on the 4th, North Korea notified South Korea of a list of 39 visitors on the 1st, including 27 players (including 4 reserve players) and 12 staff members. They are scheduled to enter South Korea via Incheon International Airport from Beijing, China, on the 17th. (4일 통일부에 따르면 북한은 지난 1일 예비선수 4명을 포함한 선수 27명과 스텝 12명 등 총 39명 방남 명단을 통보해왔다. 이들은 오는 17일 중국 베이징에서 인천공항을 통해 입국할 예정이다.)

The last time North Korean athletes visited South Korea was in 2018. In that year, North Korea sent teams to the World Shooting Championships in Changwon, Gyeongsangnam-do, in September; the Aris Sports Cup International Youth Football Tournament in October; and the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) 2018 World Tour Grand Finals unified team mixed doubles event in December. The last visit by a North Korean women's football team was for the 2014 Incheon Asian Games. (북한 체육인의 남한 방문은 2018년이 마지막이다. 북한은 2018년 9월 경남 창원에서 열린 세계사격선수권 대회, 10월 아리스포츠컵 국제유소년 축구대회, 12월 국제탁구연맹(ITTF) 2018 월드투어 그랜드파이널스대회 단일팀 혼합복식 경기에 선수단을 파견했다. 여자 축구팀의 방남은 2014년 인천 아시안게임이 마지막이다.)

“Naegohyang Women’s Football Team,” based in Pyongyang, North Korea, was founded in 2012 and is sponsored by the North Korean consumer goods company “Naegohyang.” Many of its players are national team-level athletes with recent experience winning age-group World Cups (U-17 and U-20). Ri Yu-il, former head coach of the North Korean women’s national team, serves as the team’s manager. Naegohyang will face Suwon FC Women in a semifinal match on the 20th at 7:00 PM at Suwon Sports Complex. The losing team in the semifinal is scheduled to return to North Korea the following day, the 21st. (북한 평양에 연고를 둔 ‘내고향여자축구단’은 2012년 창단했고 북한의 소비재 기업인 ‘내고향’의 후원을 받는 축구단이다. 선수단 상당수가 최근 연령별 월드컵(U-17·U-20) 우승 경험이 있는 국가대표급 선수로 구성되어 있다. 북한 여자 국가대표팀 감독을 지낸 리유일이 감독을 맡고 있다. 내고향축구단은 오는 20일 수원종합운동장에서 오후 7시에 수원FC위민과 준결승전을 치른다. 준결승에서 패배한 팀은 경기 다음날인 21일 바로 본국으로 복귀할 예정이다.)

North Korean women’s football has recently achieved strong results in international competitions. They won their record fourth FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in 2025, and in 2024, they clinched both the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup and the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. Earlier this month, they advanced to the final of the AFC U-20 Women’s Asian Cup in Thailand but lost 0-1 to Japan, finishing as runners-up. (북한의 여자축구는 최근 국제대회에서 좋은 성적을 거두고 있다. 2025년 FIFA U-17(17세이하) 여자월드컵에서 역대 최다인 4번째 우승을 차지했고 2024년에는 FIFA U-20 여자월드컵과 U-17 여자월드컵에서 모두 우승했다. 이달초에는 태국에서 열린 AFC U-20 여자아시안컵에서 결승까지 올라 일본에 0-1로 패해 준우승했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Internal Disagreements Over Special Counsel Bill... Some Capital Region Campaigns Hold Emergency Meetings ([단독] 與 특검법 당내 이견…일부 수도권 캠프도 긴급회의)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Internal Disagreements Over Special Counsel Bill... Some Capital Region Campaigns Hold Emergency Meetings ([단독] 與 특검법 당내 이견…일부 수도권 캠프도 긴급회의 )

Regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's proposal of the "Special Counsel Bill on Allegations of Manipulated Investigations and Indictments by the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration," which would allow for the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, internal disagreements have emerged within the party. The party leadership had planned to table and handle the special counsel bill as early as the plenary session on the 7th. <<> Ahead of the June 3 local elections, some campaigns in the capital region reportedly held emergency meetings on this day, taking the stance that "passing it before the election is inappropriate." <<> Earlier, in a group Telegram chat where Democratic Party lawmakers gathered, opinions reportedly emerged, mainly from lawmakers in the TK (Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province) region, suggesting that "the handling of the special counsel bill should be postponed until after the local elections." <<> A source from a capital region campaign stated, "There are concerns and consensus not only in TK but also in the capital region that the timing of the special counsel bill needs adjustment. We will hold a meeting to decide how to convey a message to the party leadership." <<> In particular, in the Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang Province, and Daegu, North Gyeongsang Province regions, there is a sensitive reception of the potential impact of the special counsel bill on the elections. According to a survey by Korea Information Research and Cheonji Ilbo on the 27th and 28th of last month, support for the "special counsel's authority to withdraw indictments" stood at 42.9%, with opposition at 38.1%, within the margin of error. However, in Daegu, North Gyeongsang Province, and Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang Province, opposition rates were 48.2% and 46.2%, respectively, surpassing support rates of 37.6% and 37.8%. (더불어민주당이 이재명 대통령에 대한 공소 취소를 가능하도록 하는 ‘윤석열 정부 조작 수사·기소 의혹 특검법안’을 발의한 것과 관련, 당내에서도 이견이 표출되고 있다. 당 지도부는 이르면 7일 본회의에서 특검법을 상정하고 처리할 계획이었다.)

item.title: “Chung Jin-suk Should Be in Hiding” – Kim Tae-heum Indefinitely Postpones Candidacy Registration (“정진석 자숙해야” 김태흠, 후보 등록 무기한 연기)
item.description:
“Chung Jin-suk Should Be in Hiding” – Kim Tae-heum Indefinitely Postpones Candidacy Registration (“정진석 자숙해야” 김태흠, 후보 등록 무기한 연기)

Chungcheongnam-do Governor Kim Tae-heum announced on the 4th that he would indefinitely postpone the registration schedule for preliminary candidates in the local elections. (김태흠 충남지사가 4일 지방선거 예비후보 등록 일정을 무기한 연기한다고 밝혔다.)

Governor Kim’s side stated on the same day, “We have decided to postpone the preliminary candidate registration and the press conference for the candidacy declaration scheduled for the 6th.” Governor Kim had originally planned to register as a preliminary candidate for the People Power Party’s Chungcheongnam-do gubernatorial race on that day. This decision is interpreted as a backlash against the application for nomination in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, Chungcheongnam-do, by former National Assembly Vice Speaker Chung Jin-suk, who previously served as Chief of Staff to President Yoon Suk-yeol. (김 지사 측은 이날 “예비후보 등록과 오는 6일 출마 선언 기자회견을 연기하기로 했다”고 공지했다. 김 지사는 당초 이날 국민의힘 충남도지사 예비후보로 등록할 예정이었다. 이같은 결정은 윤석열 대통령 비서실장을 지낸 정진석 전 국회 부의장의 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 공천 신청에 따른 반발로 풀이된다.)

Appearing on Channel A’s YouTube channel on the morning of the same day, Governor Kim stated, “I was unable to register as a preliminary candidate today because the issue of former Vice Speaker Chung’s (nomination) has not been resolved.” He added, “In a situation where former President Yoon Suk-yeol was impeached through martial law and lost power, at the very least, someone who last served as (former President Yoon’s) chief of staff should be in hiding,” and noted, “I conveyed my concerns in advance, considering whether (Chung) should make a universal and common-sense judgment.” (김 지사는 이날 오전 채널A 유튜브에 출연해 “정 전 부의장 (공천) 문제가 해결되지 않아 오늘 예비 후보 등록을 하지 못했다”고 했다. 그는 “윤석열 전 대통령이 계엄을 통해 탄핵을 당하고 정권도 뺏긴 상황에서 적어도 (윤 전 대통령) 비서실장을 마지막으로 했던 분이라면 자숙을 해야 하는 것”이라며 “보편적이고 상식적인 판단을 해야 하는 것 아닌지 하는 측면에서 사전에 우려를 전달했다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, Governor Kim hinted at leaving the party and running as an independent over former Vice Speaker Chung’s nomination application. In a statement posted on Facebook on the 2nd, he said, “I can’t hide my heartbreak over the nomination process for former Vice Speaker Chung,” and added, “If it goes against the national conscience without reflection, I have no choice but to leave.” (앞서 김 지사는 정 전 부의장 공천 신청을 두고 탈당과 무소속 출마 의사까지도 시사했다. 그는 2일 페이스북에 낸 입장문에서 “정 전 부의장의 공천 과정에 억장이 무너지는 심정을 감출 길 없다”며 “반성 없이 국민적 양심에 반한다면 떠날 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

On the same day, when asked, “Do you still intend to leave the party if former Vice Speaker Chung is nominated?” he replied, “Yes.” (이날도 “정 전 부의장 공천을 한다면 탈당하겠다는 의사는 여전하냐”는 질문에 “그렇다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party’s Nomination Management Committee previously nominated former lawmaker Lee Yong (Gyeonggi Hanam-gu), who served as former President Yoon’s executive team leader; former Korea Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong), evaluated as a strong pro-Yoon figure; and former Korea Communications Commission Vice Chairperson Kim Tae-gyu (Ulsan Nam-gu), as candidates for the National Assembly by-election. (국민의힘 공관위는 앞서 윤 전 대통령의 수행팀장 출신인 이용 전 의원(경기 하남갑), 강성 친윤 성향으로 평가받은 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장(대구 달성), 김태규 전 방통위 부위원장(울산 남갑) 등을 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 공천했다.)

Regarding the nomination of former lawmaker Lee, Governor Kim said, “He served as the party’s district committee chairperson in that area, and as for former President Yoon’s martial law, isn’t former lawmaker Lee not involved in that?” As for former Chairperson Lee, he added, “She expressed her own position on the martial law, but didn’t she not endorse it?” (김 지사는 이 전 의원 공천에 대해서는 “그 지역의 당협위원장을 맡았고 또 윤 전 대통령 계엄이라는 부분에 대해서 이 전 의원은 관련이 없지 않느냐”고 했다. 이 전 위원장에 대해서도 “계엄에 대해 자기 입장을 밝힌 것이지 계엄에 동조한 부분은 없지 않느냐”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the People Power Party’s Nomination Management Committee was reportedly planning to hold a full meeting on the afternoon of the same day to discuss former Vice Speaker Chung’s nomination application for the National Assembly by-election. The previous day, Nomination Management Committee Chairperson Park Deok-heum posted on Facebook regarding Governor Kim’s concerns, saying, “It’s heartbreaking to talk about something that hasn’t even happened,” and added, “If the nomination result turns out differently from the expectations of the people and our party, then talk about it.” (한편 국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 이날 오후 전체 회의를 열고 정 전 부의장의 국회의원 보궐선거 공천 신청에 대한 논의를 진행할 것으로 알려졌다. 전날 박덕흠 공천관리위원장은 페이스북에 김 지사의 우려에 대해 “일어나지도 않을 일을 두고 이야기하니 억장이 무너진다”며 “공천 결과가 국민과 우리 당 기대와 다르게 나오면 그때 이야기하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil on Jung Cheong-rae's 'Oppa' Controversy: "Better Not to Mess Up, Just Leave It to Jeon Jae-su" (‘오빠’ 구설 정청래에 송영길 “또 실수 말고 그냥 전재수에 맡겨야”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil on Jung Cheong-rae's 'Oppa' Controversy: "Better Not to Mess Up, Just Leave It to Jeon Jae-su" (‘오빠’ 구설 정청래에 송영길 “또 실수 말고 그냥 전재수에 맡겨야”)

Amid controversy over Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae's remark telling a first-grade elementary school girl to "try calling me oppa" during a visit to Gupo Market in Busan on the 3rd, former party leader Song Young-gil said on the 4th, "In the case of Busan, the public sentiment I've gathered is that the basic view is, 'We wish it could be left to candidate Jeon Jae-su (for Busan mayor).'" <<> In response to a host's question on YTN Radio that day asking, "Do you think Representative Jung Cheong-rae's moves are helpful for elections in the Yeongnam region?", Song criticized, "Candidate Jeon Jae-su has good evaluations and a clear vision for Busan as a maritime capital, so rather than having the central leadership go there and make mistakes, it would be better just to support him." <<> The previous day, Representative Jung visited Gupo Market in Busan alongside Ha Jung-woo, the strategic nominee for the by-election in Buk-gu, Busan's first district (former presidential secretary for AI future planning), and repeatedly made remarks to an elementary school student, such as calling himself "Jung-woo oppa" and telling her to "try saying oppa," sparking controversy. As backlash intensified, including a fierce offensive from the opposition party, Representative Jung and Ha issued a formal apology that night. <<> Representative Jung stated, "Regarding the situation during the Gupo Market visit, I feel sorry to the child and her parents for putting the child at the center of controversy and causing hurt," while Ha also said, "I apologize to the child and parents who may have been hurt. I will be more cautious and meet residents with a humble and low-key attitude." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 지난 3일 부산 구포시장을 찾았다가 초1 여아에게 “오빠해봐”라고 발언한 것이 논란이 된 가운데, 송영길 전 대표가 “부산 같은 경우 제가 파악한 여론은 ‘전재수 (부산시장) 후보한테 맡겨 놨으면 좋겠다’는 게 기본 생각”이라고 4일 말했다.)

item.title: Choo Kyung-ho and Lee Cheol-woo Preliminary Candidates Visit Former President Park Geun-hye (추경호·이철우 예비후보, 박근혜 전 대통령 예방)
item.description:
Choo Kyung-ho and Lee Cheol-woo Preliminary Candidates Visit Former President Park Geun-hye (추경호·이철우 예비후보, 박근혜 전 대통령 예방)

<<>> People Power Party’s preliminary candidate for Daegu mayor, Choo Kyung-ho, and preliminary candidate for Gyeongbuk governor, Lee Cheol-woo, visited former President Park Geun-hye on the 4th. The two preliminary candidates arrived at former President Park’s residence in Dalseong-gun, Daegu, around 2 p.m. and spoke with her for about 40 minutes. Lee In-seon, chair of the People Power Party’s Daegu city chapter, and Koo Ja-geun, chair of the Gyeongbuk provincial chapter, also attended the meeting. ()

Regarding the reason for the visit, preliminary candidate Choo explained, “As a former president of our party and a great figure in conservative politics, I believed it was only proper to pay respects since she resides in Dalseong-gun.” (국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 예비후보와 이철우 경북지사 예비후보는 4일 박근혜 전 대통령을 예방했다. 두 예비후보는 이날 오후 2시쯤 대구 달성군 박 전 대통령 사저를 찾아 40여 분간 박 전 대통령과 이야기를 나눴다. 이 자리에는 이인선 국민의힘 대구시당위원장과 구자근 경북도당위원장도 함께했다.)

After the visit, preliminary candidate Choo said, “She expressed concerns that recent domestic and international situations are not stable and emphasized that in times like these, we must protect liberal democracy and that Daegu should play its role as the center of conservatism.” He added, “She told me, ‘Hasn’t Dalseong-gun grown to the point of a dramatic transformation?’ and urged me to use that experience to revive Daegu’s economy.” Choo continued, “I take her words seriously. I will surely revive Daegu’s economy and protect the heart of conservatism.” (이날 예방한 이유에 대해 추 예비후보는 “우리 당의 전직 대통령이자 보수 정치의 큰 어른으로, 달성군에 계신 만큼 인사를 드리는 것이 도리라고 생각했다”고 설명했다.)

Preliminary candidate Lee, who was also present, stated, “Like a queen of elections, she showed great concern about the elections in Daegu and Gyeongbuk.” He added, “When I asked if she might consider stepping out since citizens are eagerly waiting, she replied, ‘I will do so someday.’” Lee further noted that he requested a visit to the Gyeongbuk provincial government building, where a statue of former President Park Chung-hee stands. (예방 이후 추 예비후보는 “최근 국내외 상황이 편안하지 않다는 우려와 함께 이럴 때일수록 자유민주주의를 지키고, 대구가 보수의 중심으로서 역할을 해야 한다는 말씀을 하셨다”며 “저에게 달성군이 천지개벽할 정도로 성장하지 않았느냐, 그 경험을 살려 대구 경제를 반드시 살려 달라는 당부를 하셨다”고 전했다. 추 예비후보는 “박 전 대통령의 말씀을 무겁게 받아들이고, 대구 경제를 반드시 살리고, 보수 심장을 지키겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

It was reported that no mention was made at the meeting regarding Lee Jin-sook, former chair of the Korea Communications Commission, who recently received the People Power Party’s nomination for the Dalseong-gun by-election for a National Assembly seat. (함께 자리한 이 예비후보는 “선거의 여왕답게 대구와 경북 선거에 대해 많은 걱정을 해주셨다”며 “시민들이 많이 기다리고 있으니, 나들이하는 게 어떠냐고 여쭸더니 ‘언젠가는 하겠다’고 답했다”고 밝혔다. 이와 더불어 경북도청에 박정희 전 대통령 동상이 세워져 있는 만큼 방문을 요청했다고 이 예비후보는 덧붙였다.)

<<>> (이 자리에서는 최근 달성군 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 공천을 받은 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장 관련 언급은 없었던 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae and Ha Jung-woo Apologize in Tandem After Controversy Over Telling a First-Grade Girl to “Call Him Oppa” (정청래·하정우, 초1 여아에 “오빠해봐” 논란되자 나란히 사과)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae and Ha Jung-woo Apologize in Tandem After Controversy Over Telling a First-Grade Girl to “Call Him Oppa” (정청래·하정우, 초1 여아에 “오빠해봐” 논란되자 나란히 사과)

On the 3rd, Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Ha Jung-woo, by-election candidate for Busan's Buk-gu-Gangseo district, bowed their heads in apology, saying: “We are sorry to the child, who may have been hurt by being placed at the center of controversy, and to the child’s parents.” <<> The apology came after controversy erupted over an incident during a visit to Busan's Gupo Market, where Rep. Jeong told a first-grade elementary school girl to call candidate Ha “oppa” (older brother). <<> Candidate Ha also issued a statement via his campaign notice that afternoon: “During today’s meeting with local residents, a child ended up at the center of controversy,” and added: “I apologize to the child and parents who may have been hurt by this. I will meet with residents with greater caution and a humble attitude.” <<> On that day, at Gupo Market in Ha's electoral district, Rep. Jeong said to a first-grade girl: “What grade are you in? This is Jeong-woo oppa. Try calling him oppa.” Candidate Ha also said, “Oppa.” <<> When a video of the scene was released, opposition parties criticized it as inappropriate. Lawmaker Seong Il-jong stated: “The two repeatedly urging a hesitant child to ‘say oppa’ is tantamount to child abuse.” <<> Park Jeong-hoon, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, remarked: “Ha Jung-woo, the former senior secretary, laughing and echoing ‘oppa’ is equally deplorable.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 하정우 부산북갑 보궐 후보자가 “아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 돼 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구하다”고 3일 나란히 고개를 숙였다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: Cancelling Prosecution of Lee's Case... "Turning a Blind Eye to Victim Relief Because of Presidency Violates Constitutional Spirit" (정청래, 李 공소취소 특검법에 “대통령이란 이유로 피해구제 외면, 헌법 정신에 어긋나”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: Cancelling Prosecution of Lee's Case... "Turning a Blind Eye to Victim Relief Because of Presidency Violates Constitutional Spirit" (정청래, 李 공소취소 특검법에 “대통령이란 이유로 피해구제 외면, 헌법 정신에 어긋나”)

Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 4th regarding the "Special Counsel Bill on Allegations of Manipulated Investigations and Indictments by the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration," which includes a provision to cancel the indictment in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung, that "the special counsel for manipulated indictments is a process of judicial normalization to correct the errors of the Yoon Suk Yeol authoritarian prosecution regime." (더불어민주당 정청래 대표는 4일 이재명 대통령 관련 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 조항을 담은 ‘윤석열 정부 조작 수사·기소 의혹 특검법안’과 관련해 “조작 기소 특검은 윤석열 검찰 독재 정권의 과오를 바로 잡는 사법 정상화의 과정”이라고 했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center, Leader Jung said, "We must rectify the lawless atrocities of the Yoon Suk Yeol authoritarian prosecution regime." (정 대표는 이날 부산항 국제 전시컨벤션센터에서 열린 최고위원 회의에서 “윤석열 검찰 독재 정권의 무도한 악행을 바로 잡아야 한다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung also stated, "Through this parliamentary investigation, the hideous circumstances of manipulated investigations by the Yoon Suk Yeol authoritarian prosecution regime, aimed at eliminating political rivals, have been fully exposed," adding, "It is difficult to even list all the illegal acts committed by the prosecution, such as selective evidence collection and manipulation, plea bargains, and witness coercion, to fabricate crimes targeting President Lee Jae-myung." (또 정 대표는 “이번 국정조사를 통해 정적 제거를 목적으로 한 윤석열 검찰 독재 정권의 추악한 조작 수사 정황이 낱낱이 드러났다”며 “선택적 증거 수집과 조작, 형량 거래와 진술 회유 등 이재명 대통령을 타깃으로 없는 죄를 만들기 위해 검찰이 행한 위법 행위는 일일이 열거하기조차 어렵다”고 했다.)

He further remarked, "Not only President Lee, but also lawyer Nam Wook, former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young, and many others have had their lives torn apart by the prosecution's manipulated investigations," and "We can no longer stand by and watch as truth is distorted by political prosecutors and countless innocent victims are created." (그러면서 “이 대통령뿐만 아니라 남욱 변호사, 이화영 전 (경기도) 평화부지사 등 수많은 관련자가 검찰의 조작 수사로 인생이 난도질당했다”며 “더 이상 정치검찰에 의해 진실이 뒤바뀌고 억울한 피해자가 양산되는 비극을 좌시할 수는 없다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung noted, "As Article 11 of the Constitution clearly states, all citizens are equal before the law," and "This applies equally to victim relief." (정 대표는 “헌법 제11조가 명시하듯 모든 국민은 법 앞에 평등하다”며 “피해 구제에서도 마찬가지”라고 했다.)

He added, "Turning a blind eye to legitimate victim relief because someone is president goes against the spirit of the Constitution," and "If there are unjust damages from manipulated indictments, anyone must clearly uncover the truth and receive just compensation." (그러면서 “대통령이라는 이유로 정당한 피해 구제를 외면하는 것은 헌법 정신에 어긋난다”며 “조작 기소로 억울한 피해가 있다면 그 어느 누구라도 명명백백히 진실을 찾고 정당한 보상을 받아야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Reform Party's Cho Eung-cheon Proposes National Petition to People Power Party to Block Special Counsel for Dropping President Lee's Indictment (개혁신당 조응천, 국힘에 李대통령 공소 취소 특검 저지 ‘대국민 서명’ 제안)
item.description:
Reform Party's Cho Eung-cheon Proposes National Petition to People Power Party to Block Special Counsel for Dropping President Lee's Indictment (개혁신당 조응천, 국힘에 李대통령 공소 취소 특검 저지 ‘대국민 서명’ 제안)

Reform Party Gyeonggi Governor candidate Cho Eung-cheon plans to propose a national petition to block the handling of the "fabricated indictment" special counsel bill, which would allow for the dismissal of President Lee Jae-myung's case, during a meeting with opposition candidates running in the metropolitan area on the 4th. <<> People Power Party Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon, Incheon Mayor candidate Yoo Jeong-bok, Reform Party candidate Cho, and Seoul Mayor candidate Kim Jeong-cheol will hold a joint meeting at the National Assembly this morning to discuss blocking the handling of the fabricated indictment special counsel bill. <<> At this meeting, candidate Cho is expected to propose a national petition opposing the handling of the special counsel bill and discuss the development of an online platform for this purpose. Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok and others are reportedly already involved in the development of the website. <<> Earlier, candidate Cho proposed an emergency joint meeting of metropolitan area mayoral candidates at a press conference the previous day, urging various parties to join forces to block the passage of the special counsel bill initiated by the Democratic Party of Korea. Cho stated, "If the Democratic Party persists in pushing forward with the special counsel to drop President Lee's indictment, the constitutional system of the rule of law and the separation of powers will be fundamentally shaken, and South Korea's criminal justice order will be rendered hollow." Candidates including Oh responded positively, leading to today's meeting. (개혁신당 조응천 경기지사 후보는 4일 수도권 출마 야당 후보들과 만나 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 처리 저지를 위한 대국민 서명을 제안할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Lee: "Public Consensus on Special Counsel for Fabricated Indictments; Timing and Process Must Undergo Deliberation" (李 “조작기소 특검에 국민 공감대, 처리 시기·절차는 숙의 거쳐야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Public Consensus on Special Counsel for Fabricated Indictments; Timing and Process Must Undergo Deliberation" (李 “조작기소 특검에 국민 공감대, 처리 시기·절차는 숙의 거쳐야”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 4th requested, regarding the timing of the National Assembly's passage of the "Special Counsel Act for Fabricated Indictments" proposed by the Democratic Party of Korea, "As for the specific timing or procedures, I ask that the ruling Democratic Party make a judgment after gathering public opinions and going through a deliberation process." <<> Chief of Presidential Office for Political Affairs, Hong Ik-pyo, announced the President's request during a briefing that morning. Chief Hong stated, "Through the 'Parliamentary Investigation to Uncover the Truth Behind the Suspicions of Fabricated Indictments by the Yoon Seok-yeol Regime and Political Prosecutors,' the illegal acts and unjust investigations carried out by the Yoon Seok-yeol regime and political prosecutors at the time have been largely revealed, and a public consensus has formed regarding the need for a special counsel investigation to rectify this," adding, "Uncovering the truth and restoring judicial justice through a special counsel is an essential task." <<> However, Chief Hong said, "However, regarding the specific timing or procedures for this, the President stated that he asks the ruling Democratic Party to make a judgment after gathering public opinions and going through a deliberation process." <<> The Presidential Office had previously only stated regarding the Special Counsel Act for Fabricated Indictments, "It is an issue being discussed in the National Assembly, and the Presidential Office has no particular stance." For this reason, President Lee's request on this day for public opinion gathering and deliberation is effectively interpreted as meaning that the Special Counsel Act should not be processed before the June 3 local elections and by-elections for the National Assembly. The Democratic Party had planned to propose the Special Counsel Act at a plenary session of the National Assembly as early as this week, but President Lee has put a brake on this schedule. <<> Regarding the Special Counsel Act proposed by the Democratic Party, legal circles and others pointed out its inclusion of all cases where President Lee has been indicted and the special counsel's authority to even revoke indictments, leading to criticism labeling it "unconstitutional" and "a special counsel for President Lee's indictment revocation." Concerns also emerged within the Democratic Party, such as, "Pushing through the Special Counsel Act could become a major setback in the local elections." A pro-government source commented, "In the end, because it was predicted that the impact on the local elections would be significant, President Lee personally stepped in to shelve the processing of the Special Counsel Act." <<> However, the Presidential Office on this day clearly expressed its approval of the purpose and necessity of the Special Counsel Act, stating that "a public consensus has formed" and that "it is an essential task." Within the Democratic Party, remarks were also made such as, "Doesn't this mean we should delay the processing of the Special Counsel Act for a while and proceed with it only after the local elections?" (이재명 대통령이 4일 더불어민주당이 발의한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’의 국회 통과 시기에 대해 “구체적인 시기나 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해 달라”고 요청했다.)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum urges caution on special counsel bill for withdrawal of indictment: "Unless you plan to abandon your comrades" (김부겸, 공소취소 특검법에 “동지 버릴 셈 아니라면 신중해야”)
item.description:
Kim Boo-kyum urges caution on special counsel bill for withdrawal of indictment: "Unless you plan to abandon your comrades" (김부겸, 공소취소 특검법에 “동지 버릴 셈 아니라면 신중해야”)

Former Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum, running as the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for mayor of Daegu in the June 3 local elections, urged the party leadership to "handle the legislation cautiously" regarding the "Special Counsel Bill on the Yoon Suk Yeol administration's manipulated indictments." (6·3 지방선거 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보로 나선 김부겸 전 국무총리가 당 지도부가 추진 중인 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 특검법’을 두고 “법안 처리를 신중해달라”고 당부했다.)

At the Daegu City Party's "March to Victory" rally on the 3rd, candidate Kim said, "Because you all see the overall political landscape, a careless remark or a bill you think is necessary—if you don't intend to abandon the comrades struggling and running here, I would ask you to be cautious." (김 후보는 지난 3일 대구시당 필승 전진대회에서 “여러분들이 정국 전체를 보기 때문에 쉽게 던지는 말 한마디, 여러분들이 필요하다고 생각하는 법안 하나, 여기서 이 고생하면서 뛰고 있는 동지들을 버릴 셈이 아니라면, 신중해달라고 요청드리고 싶다”고 했다.)

This remark came amid concerns over the potential negative impact on the election of the special counsel bill, jointly introduced on the 30th of last month by acting floor leader Cheon Jun-ho and other party leadership. The bill includes provisions allowing a special counsel to withdraw indictments in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung. (지난달 30일 천준호 민주당 원내대표 권한대행 등 원내지도부가 대표 발의한 특검법을 두고 선거에 미칠 악영향을 우려해 한 말이었다. 해당 법안은 이재명 대통령 관련 사건을 특검이 공소 취소할 수 있는 권한을 포함하고 있다.)

Candidate Kim stated, "In Daegu, following Kim Dae-jung at 8%, Roh Moo-hyun at 18%, Moon Jae-in at 22%, and Lee Jae-myung at 23%, our approval rating is finally holding at 30%," adding, "That shows Daegu citizens are ready to embrace change." (김 후보는 “대구에서 김대중 8%, 노무현 18%, 문재인 22%, 이재명 23%에 이어 이제 지지율이 드디어 30%를 지키고 있다”며 “그만큼 대구시민들이 변화를 받아들일 준비가 되어 있다는 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim then added, "So I hope you won't make careless remarks or statements that hurt Daegu citizens," and asked, "Please help Daegu citizens make rational judgments." (김 후보는 그러면서 “그래서 여러분들이 그렇게 함부로 대구시민들에게 상처를 주는 발언이나 이야기는 하지 않았으면 좋겠다”며 “대구시민들이 합리적인 판단을 내릴 수 있도록 도와달라”고 말했다.)

He also said, "Daegu citizens know how to 'tame' the Democratic Party," adding, "If they think the Democratic Party is acting up, they change everything. They know how to use political parties as their errand runners." (또 “대구시민들은 민주당을 길들일 줄 아신다”며 “민주당이 까분다 싶으면 모조리 바꾸신다. 그분들은 정당을 자기들의 심부름꾼으로 쓰실 줄 아신다”고 했다.)

The former Prime Minister said, "In difficult times, in a difficult region, comrade, to engage in this arduous task of politics under the Democratic Party banner in Daegu, you need a sense of justice," and emphasized, "What we do is not about making ourselves live well. Everything should always be from the citizens' perspective, thinking based on their benefit, as we campaign." (김 전 총리는 “어려운 시기에, 어려운 지역에서 뛰고 있는 동지 여러분, 대구에서 민주당 간판을 달고 정치를 하는 이 고생스러운 일을 하기 위해서는 정의감이 있어야 한다”면서 “우리가 하는 일이, 우리가 잘 살자고 하는 일이 아니다. 모든 것은 항상 시민의 눈높이에서, 시민의 편익을 기준으로 생각하면서 선거운동을 해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yang Hyang-ja: "A Unified Candidacy with Jo Eung-cheon? I Haven't Even Considered It... I'll Win as the People Power Party Candidate" (양향자 “조응천과 단일화? 전혀 생각 안해... 국힘 후보로 이기겠다”)
item.description:
Yang Hyang-ja: "A Unified Candidacy with Jo Eung-cheon? I Haven't Even Considered It... I'll Win as the People Power Party Candidate" (양향자 “조응천과 단일화? 전혀 생각 안해... 국힘 후보로 이기겠다”)

People Power Party's Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Yang Hyang-ja stated on the 4th regarding the possibility of a unified candidacy with Reform New Party's Jo Eung-cheon, "I'm not even thinking about it right now." In political circles, there had been speculation about an opposition alliance between Yang and Jo to defeat Democratic Party's Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Choo Mi-ae, but Yang denied this. (국민의힘 양향자 경기지사 후보는 4일 개혁신당 조응천 후보와의 단일화 여부에 대해 “지금은 전혀 생각을 안 하고 있다”고 했다. 정치권에선 더불어민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보를 이기기 위해 양향자·조응천 후보의 야권 연대 가능성이 제기됐는데 양 후보가 이를 부인한 것이다.)

Appearing on KBS Radio that day, Yang said, "I know that if the People Power Party can't beat the Democratic Party, any form of unification won't be easy. As the People Power Party candidate, I will win with dignity," adding the above remarks. Previously, on the 28th of last month while still in the primaries, she had stated, "Any forces seeking to prevent the ruling party's dictatorship must stand together," marking a shift in her position. (양 후보는 이날 KBS 라디오에 출연해 “국민의힘이 민주당을 이길 수 없다면 어떤 단일화를 해도 쉽지 않다는 것을 알고 있다. 국민의힘 후보로서 당당하게 이기겠다”며 이같이 말했다. 앞서 양 후보는 경선 중이던 지난달 28일에는 “여당 독재를 막고자 하는 세력은 어떤 세력이라도 함께 해야 한다”고 했었는데 입장을 바꾼 것이다.)

Yang stated, "I see three criteria for a possible unified candidacy," adding, "First, the candidate must prioritize revitalizing Gyeonggi Province's economy." She continued, "Second, they must have a clear philosophy and commitment to innovative conservatism—if we must talk about conservatism, it should be that kind of future-oriented, innovative conservatism—and they must agree to check the Democratic Party's arrogance and dominance." (양 후보는 “단일화가 가능한 세력은 세 가지로 본다”며 “우선 경기도의 경제 살리기를 최우선 과제로 삼을 수 있는 후보라야 된다”고 했다. 이어 그는 “두 번째는 혁신 보수, 굳이 보수를 따지자면 그런 미래의 보수, 혁신 보수에 대한 철학과 의지가 분명해야 하고, 민주당의 오만과 독주를 견제하자는 데 동의를 해야 한다”고 했다.)

Yang said, "In that respect, I believe there are no forces I cannot work with, but we must win as the People Power Party. If we start thinking about unification now with such a weak mindset, I don't think we'll win the election." (양 후보는 “그런 부분에 있어서 저는 어떤 세력이라도 함께하지 못하는 세력은 없다고 보지만 국민의힘으로 승리해야지 지금부터 단일화를 생각하는 그런 나약한 정신 상태로는 저는 선거 못 이긴다고 본다”고 했다.)

Yang also did not attend the "Emergency Joint Meeting of Metropolitan Area Regional Government Heads Candidates to Prevent Judicial Insurrection" held at the National Assembly that morning at Jo's suggestion. The meeting was attended by People Power Party's Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Incheon Mayor candidate Yoo Jeong-bok, and Reform New Party's Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Jo Eung-cheon and Seoul Mayor candidate Kim Jeong-cheol, totaling four people. Yang left after taking a commemorative photo, citing a prior engagement. (또한 양 후보는 조 후보의 제안으로 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 ‘사법내란 저지를 위한 수도권 광역단체장 후보자 긴급 연석회의’에도 불참했다. 이날 연석회의에는 국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장·유정복 인천시장 후보와 개혁신당 조응천 경기지사·김정철 서울시장 후보 등 4명이 참석했다. 양 후보는 기념 촬영을 한 뒤 “선약이 있다”며 회의장을 떠났다.)

item.title: Kim: “Make Gimhae the Center of the Megacity” vs. Park: “Create a World-Class Children’s Playground” (金 “김해를 메가시티 중심으로” vs 朴 “세계적 어린이 놀이터 조성”)
item.description:
Kim: “Make Gimhae the Center of the Megacity” vs. Park: “Create a World-Class Children’s Playground” (金 “김해를 메가시티 중심으로” vs 朴 “세계적 어린이 놀이터 조성”)

In the June 3 local elections for the Gyeongsangnam-do governor seat, rival candidates from the ruling and opposition parties have unveiled tailored pledges targeting specific regions and generations to win over voters. Kim Gyeong-su of the Democratic Party of Korea, aiming for a comeback, promised to foster Gimhae as a central city of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam megacity, including building a new KTX Gimhae Station. Park Wan-su of the People Power Party, seeking re-election, countered ahead of Children’s Day by proposing the creation of a world-class children’s play facility. <<> On the morning of the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Kim, together with Gimhae mayor candidate Jeong Yeong-du, announced the “Megacity Central City Gimhae Pledge” at the Gyeongnam Provincial Government Press Center. <<> The core of the two candidates’ pledge is to develop Gimhae into a central city of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam megacity. <<> To this end, they put forward the card of establishing a new KTX Gimhae Station. This involves building a “KTX Gimhae Station” at the intersection where the Busan New Port Line and the Busanjin-Masan double-track railway meet. The plan is to create an integrated transfer hub connecting the South Coast Regional Express Railway, the Busanjin-Masan double-track railway, and the Southeast Regional Circular Express Railway, aiming to make key points in the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam region accessible from anywhere in Gimhae within 30 minutes. <<> Candidate Jeong added, “We will complete the great transformation of Gimhae with a structure where the governor designs and the mayor executes,” and “We will establish the ‘Roh Moo-hyun Convention Center’ in the KTX Gimhae Station area.” He also stated that the area around the station would be developed as a complex station-area development zone, combining a youth startup special zone and a content innovation town to create a new growth hub for Gimhae. <<> Candidate Kim also announced a plan to link the Gimhae Daedong Advanced Industrial Complex with the Jillye Techno Valley to create a 300,000-pyeong-scale “AI Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Special Zone.” In the medical field, he promised to establish a public medical center for the eastern Gyeongnam region in Gimhae. <<> Gimhae is the second-largest city in Gyeongnam after Changwon, with a population of 530,000 and an annual budget of 2.48 trillion won. It is the hometown of former President Roh Moo-hyun. Along with Yangsan, it is referred to as the “Nakdong River Belt,” a region where Democratic Party-affiliated candidates traditionally hold an advantage. A local election expert analyzed, “This is a strategy to secure a clear edge through pledges tailored to Gimhae, known as a Democratic Party stronghold.” <<> In response, Park Wan-su, the People Power Party candidate seeking re-election, announced the “Gyeongnam Monggeul Monggeul Forest Creation” pledge. <<> Seo Mi-suk, a spokesperson for Park’s campaign, held a press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Government Press Center that day, stating, “In Gyeongnam, there is insufficient infrastructure for children and parents to enjoy together, such as play spaces, cultural venues, and family leisure facilities,” and “With social changes like the spread of work-life balance and shorter working hours, there is a need for child- and family-friendly spaces where kids and parents can have fun together.” <<> The “Gyeongnam Monggeul Monggeul Forest” project was conceived by incumbent governor Park, based on his observations and reflections from on-site visits. The name combines the Chinese character “mong (夢)” meaning dream, with “wageul wageul,” depicting children laughing, chattering, and running around. It involves benchmarking advanced overseas examples like Valbyparken, a world-class nature-friendly play space in Copenhagen, Denmark, to create a children’s play area blending trees, water, and soil. <<> The plan is not just to equip a simple children’s play facility but to create a complex space where parents can rest and interact, and families can stay together. It will incorporate specialized content reflecting Gyeongnam’s natural and industrial assets, such as the Jirisan Forest, the South Sea marine ecosystem, robots, and aerospace. <<> Spokesperson Seo said, “This year, the initial budget has included funds for basic planning and feasibility study services, so preliminary preparations have begun,” adding, “During the process, we will broadly gather opinions from residents and experts, and based on the study results, we will solicit and select the target site.” <<> (6·3지방선거 경남도지사 자리를 놓고 맞붙은 여야 후보들이 유권자 표심을 잡기 위해 지역과 세대를 겨냥한 맞춤형 공약을 내놨다. 탈환을 노리는 더불어민주당 김경수 후보는 김해를 부울경 메가시티의 중심도시로 육성하겠다며 KTX김해역 신설 등을 약속했다. 재선을 노리는 국민의힘 박완수 후보는 어린이날을 앞두고 세계적인 수준의 어린이 놀이시설을 조성하겠다고 받아쳤다.)

item.title: People Power Party slams Lee’s request to timing adjustment for special counsel bill: “A cowardly trick fearing the June 3 election” (국힘, 李대통령 특검법 시기 조절 요청에 “6·3 선거 무서워 비겁한 꼼수”)
item.description:
People Power Party slams Lee’s request to timing adjustment for special counsel bill: “A cowardly trick fearing the June 3 election” (국힘, 李대통령 특검법 시기 조절 요청에 “6·3 선거 무서워 비겁한 꼼수”)

The People Power Party on the 4th strongly criticized President Lee Jae-myung’s request regarding the Democratic Party of Korea’s “fabricated indictment” special counsel bill, stating, “Do not deceive the public with a cowardly trick of ‘timing adjustment’ because you’re afraid of the beating you’ll get in the local elections.” (국민의힘은 4일 더불어민주당의 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 처리와 관련한 이재명 대통령의 요청에 대해 “지방선거에서 맞을 매가 무서워 ‘시기 조절’이라는 비겁한 꼼수로 국민을 기만하지 말라”면서 거세게 비판했다.)

The special counsel bill previously proposed by the Democratic Party includes provisions allowing for the withdrawal of criminal charges against President Lee. As criticism from within and outside the political sphere mounted, President Lee said on this day, “Regarding the specific timing and procedures, I ask the ruling Democratic Party to decide after gathering public opinion and going through a deliberation process,” according to a briefing by Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo. (앞서 민주당이 발의한 특검법은 이 대통령의 형사 사건 등을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 하는 내용 등이 담겼다. 이를 두고 정치권 안팎의 비판이 이어지자, 이 대통령은 이날 “구체적 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해 달라”고 말했다고 홍익표 청와대 정무수석이 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook the same day, “The Blue House has even stepped in regarding the indictment withdrawal special counsel. With dissenting voices emerging within the Democratic Party, they’ve cracked down by saying ‘if you act up, you’ll die.’” Jang continued, “(President Lee’s remarks) only called for deliberation on ‘timing’ and ‘procedures.’ It’s an order not to touch the ‘content.’” Jang claimed that President Lee requested the Democratic Party to speed up the indictment withdrawal special counsel as originally drafted, but to adjust the pace considering the June 3 local election schedule. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “공소 취소 특검에 청와대까지 나섰다. 민주당 내부에서 반대 의견이 나오니 ‘까불면 죽는다’고 찍어누른 것”이라고 했다. 이어 장 대표는 “(이 대통령의 발언은) ‘시기’와 ‘절차’만 숙의하라고 했다. ‘내용’은 건드리지 말라는 명령”이라고 했다. 이 대통령이 공소 취소 특검을 원래 내용대로 추진하되 6·3 지방선거 일정 등을 고려해 민주당에 속도 조절을 요청했다는 게 장 대표의 주장이다.)

Floor leader Song Eon-seok met with reporters after visiting Hwagok Bon-dong Market in Gangseo-gu, Seoul, and said, “This is different from the public’s will, which requires a promise to the people not to pursue an indictment withdrawal special counsel at all.” He added, “It clearly reveals an intention to push through the ‘indictment withdrawal special counsel bill’ based on the premise of a fabricated indictment.” Song went on to say, “Once the special counsel bill is brought to the plenary session, we will do our best to gather public opinion to prevent the bill from passing by all means.” Senior spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said in a commentary that day, “Even if the ‘self-absolution’ scheme is postponed until after the election, it won’t hide the sins of President Lee and the Democratic Party.” (송언석 원내대표는 이날 서울 강서구 화곡본동시장 현장 방문 이후 기자들과 만나 “공소 취소 특검 자체를 하지 않겠다는 대국민 약속이 필요하다는 국민들의 뜻과는 다른 내용”이라며 “조작 기소를 했다는 걸 전제로 ‘공소 취소 특검법’을 처리하겠다는 의지를 분명히 밝힌 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 송 원내대표는 “특검법이 본회의에 상정되면 모든 수단을 강구해 법안이 통과되지 않게 국민 뜻을 모으는 데 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다. 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “‘셀프 면죄부’ 수작을 선거 뒤로 미룬다고 해서 이 대통령과 민주당의 죄가 가려지지는 않는다”고 했다.)

Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee held an ‘Emergency Debate Criticizing the Lee Jae-myung Crime-Erasure Special Counsel Bill’ at the National Assembly that afternoon. At the event, Policy Committee Chair Jung Jeom-sik said, “Calling for deliberation is essentially a declaration to the public that President Lee will proceed with his own ‘crime erasure’ after the local elections because he’s afraid of the voter sentiment in those elections.” He called it “a legislative fraud against the people and a vile political act that thoroughly deceives voters.” (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 국민의힘 의원 등은 이날 오후 국회에서 ‘이재명 죄 지우기 특검법 규탄 긴급토론회’를 열었다. 이 자리에서 정점식 정책위의장은 “숙의를 거치자는 것은 지방선거 표심이 무서우니 지선 이후에 이 대통령 스스로 본인의 ‘죄 지우기’를 하겠다고 대국민 선언을 한 격”이라며 “국민을 향한 입법 사기이자 유권자들을 철저히 속이는 비열한 정치”라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Na Kyung-won stated, “The Blue House is deceiving the public by calculating moves, saying ‘we have no particular position’ or ‘we will approve it if there’s no unconstitutionality.’ Making a clear stance on the special counsel bill is the only way for President Lee to survive.” (나경원 의원은 “청와대는 주판알을 튀기면서 ‘별다른 입장이 없다’, ‘위헌성이 없으면 재가하겠다’며 국민을 기망하고 있다”며 “특검법에 대해 명확한 의사를 밝히는 것이 이 대통령의 살 길”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Abolishing Long-Term Holding Special Deduction is not government stance... Need to reorganize around actual residency" (김용범 “장특공제 폐지 정부입장 아냐…실거주 위주 재편 필요”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office's Policy Planning, stated that abolishing or reducing the long-term holding special deduction for single-home owners, known as the "jangteukgongje," is not the government's position. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 1주택자 장기보유특별공제, 이른바 장특공제를 폐지하거나 축소하는 것이 정부 입장이 아니라고 밝혔다.)

During a briefing on the real estate market outlook held at the Spring and Autumn Hall on the 4th, Chief Kim said, "With Representative Yoon Jong-oh's bill being introduced, some are asking if that bill represents the government's stance, but that is absolutely not the case," adding, "Representative Yoon Jong-oh's bill on the long-term holding special deduction has nothing to do with the government." He continued, "We have never stated that the long-term holding special deduction itself would change," and emphasized, "The long-term holding special deduction will naturally be maintained." (김 실장은 4일 춘추관에서 열린 부동산 시장 전망 브리핑에서 “윤종오 의원님 법안이 나오다 보니까 그 법안이 정부 입장 아니냐고 보는데 절대 그렇지 않다”며 “윤종오 의원님의 장특공제 법안과 정부는 아무 관련이 없다”고 했다. 이어 “장특공제 자체가 어떻게 된다고 말한 적이 없다”며 “장특공제는 당연히 유지된다”고 했다.)

However, Chief Kim noted, "Both residency and holding are currently at 40%, and we need to consider whether that aligns with reorganizing the housing market around actual residency." He added, "It is completely untrue that the long-term holding special deduction would decrease for actual residency," stating, "We will design the system so that there is no issue in protecting the housing of ordinary single-home owners who actually reside in their homes." (김 실장은 다만 “거주와 보유가 똑같이 지금 40% 돼 있는데, 그것이 실거주 위주로 주택시장을 재편하는 데 맞느냐에 대해서는 고민이 필요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “실제 거주에 대해 장특공제가 줄어든다는 것은 전혀 사실이 아니다”라며 “실거주형 일반 1주택자 주거 보호에는 전혀 문제가 없도록 제도를 설계하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding tax reforms, he stated, "We have previously signaled our intention to rationalize housing taxes by differentiating them by type, such as multi-home owners, non-resident single-home owners, and ultra-high-value properties," and noted, "Relevant ministries and research organizations are reviewing various alternatives." He further explained, "Directions related to real estate have been outlined multiple times," and emphasized, "The basic principle is that housing and land should be used for their intended purposes." Chief Kim also stated, "We have repeatedly made clear our position that unearned income through real estate will not be tolerated," adding, "Overall systems are being reviewed with this direction in mind." (세제 개편과 관련해서는 “다주택자, 비거주 1주택자, 초고가 등 유형별로 차등해서 주택에 대한 세제를 합리화하겠다는 것을 예고한 바 있다”며 “관련 부처와 연구 조직에서 여러 대안을 가지고 검토하고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “부동산과 관련해서는 여러 차례 방향을 설명한 바 있다”며 “주택과 토지는 본래 목적에 맞게 사용돼야 한다는 것이 기본 원칙”이라고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 “부동산을 통한 불로소득은 용납하지 않겠다는 입장을 여러 차례 밝혀왔다”며 “이 같은 방향에서 제도 전반을 검토하고 있다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Chief Kim also addressed recent supply shortages. He stated, "When high interest rates surged in 2022 and 2023, and the PF (project financing) crisis occurred, the housing supply mechanism was severely damaged." He added, "At that time, various shocks followed, such as the Legoland crisis, the Dunchon Jugong crisis, and the Korea Electric Power Corporation bond crisis. While we prevented these shocks from escalating into a systemic crisis through various measures, the supply structure was shaken as PF faced a simultaneous blow." (한편 김 실장은 최근 공급 부족에 대한 언급도 했다. 그는 “2022년과 2023년 고금리가 급격히 오고 PF 사태가 발생하면서 주택 공급 메커니즘이 크게 손상을 입었다”고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 “당시 레고랜드 사태, 둔촌주공 사태, 한전채 사태 등 여러 충격이 이어졌고, 여러 조치로 시스템 위기로 번지는 것은 막았지만 PF가 한꺼번에 충격을 받으면서 공급 구조가 흔들렸다”고 했다.)

A decline in construction starts was also cited as a major cause of supply instability. Chief Kim said, "In normal years, construction starts were about 180,000 units, but in 2022 and 2023, they dropped to around 100,000 units," noting, "Since there is a two-to-four-year time lag between start of construction and occupancy, the reduced volume from that time will translate into supply from 2025 onward." Consequently, "The aftermath of the decline in construction starts in 2022-2023 is now appearing in supply," and he stated, "2026 and 2027 could be difficult periods in terms of supply and demand balance." (착공 감소도 공급 불안의 주요 원인으로 지목됐다. 김 실장은 “평년에는 착공이 약 18만 호 수준이었는데, 2022년과 2023년에는 10만 호 수준으로 줄었다”며 “입주와 착공 사이에는 2~4년의 시차가 있기 때문에 당시 감소한 물량이 2025년 이후 공급으로 이어지게 된다”고 말했다. 이에 따라 “2022~2023년 착공 감소의 여파가 지금 공급으로 나타나고 있다”며 “2026년과 2027년은 수급 측면에서 어려운 시기가 될 수 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kim concluded, "While the economic situation is improving and demand capacity has grown, supply remains constrained due to the past decline in construction starts," adding, "Managing this supply-demand mismatch is a key challenge." (김 실장은 “경제 상황은 개선되고 수요 여력은 커졌지만, 공급은 과거 착공 감소 영향으로 제한된 상황”이라며 “이 같은 수요·공급 미스매치를 관리하는 것이 중요한 과제”라고 했다.)
